questions.stem: A Fairmont survey shows that Prescott Mattresses, a privately held firm customers report high satisfaction, yet many still switch to competitors when offered a lower price. What does this reveal?
questions.explanation: Satisfaction is a judgement about how well a product met expectations, while loyalty is a durable commitment to keep buying and resist alternatives. The survey shows high satisfaction but weak loyalty, which is common when switching is easy and competitors offer incentives. Building loyalty therefore needs more than satisfaction, such as relationship investment, convenience or genuine differentiation.
